title: Answer
description:
The flesh He took is dust that returns to dust. The one who held the power of death is the serpent of the beginning. Men still return to the ground. What is broken is the bondage of fearing that king.

The help is for the seed of Abraham, the people God took hold of. The priestly act toward God is the atonement he makes alone. The temptation is the wilderness test and the servant's grief, not a nameless trial.
